snippet.title: Xenoblade Chronicles 2: Expansion Pass - The Adventure Continues Trailer - Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
The saga continues. If you own the Xenoblade Chronicles™ 2 game and buy this Expansion Pass, you’ll gain access to some titanic new content, including new Rare Blades such as Shulk and Fiora, bonus items, new quests, Challenge Battle mode, and the new stand-alone game, Xenoblade Chronicles™ 2: Torna ~ The Golden Country!

Xenoblade Chronicles 2: Expansion Pass is available now! https://goo.gl/mxxkVw
